the-clash>sex-pistols.found: Something that inspired Strummer much more than the struggles of the 101ers was seeing a bunch of young unknowns who supported them at the Nashville on 3rd April 1976. The band went by the name of the Sex Pistols.
the-clash>sex-pistols.citation: Joe Strummer to Record Collector, on seeing the Sex Pistols support his band the 101ers at the Nashville on 3 April 1976: "I knew something was up... It was immediately clear." Record Collector adds: "Further exposure to the Pistols' live act convinced Strummer that the 101ers had to change."
